frase_gancho.texto: Voices of the desert, mountains, and coast that affirm their freedom before the horizon.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: This gallery transports visitors to the vast landscapes of the Mexican northwest, home to remarkable communities such as the Tarahumara, Yaqui, Mayo, Seri, Pura, and Pápago peoples. Along the way, it documents the deep connection between the geographic environment and ways of life adapted to mountain canyons, desert plains, and the sea coast. On display are elaborate torote baskets, ironwood carvings, ceremonial clothing, and the striking imagery of the Deer Dance. The narrative highlights their political autonomy, their spiritual strength, and the complex Holy Week festivities that protect their identity.
